properties.name: Chichén Itzá — El Castillo
properties.description: Pyramid temple of Kukulkan where the feathered serpent's shadow descends the staircase during equinoxes. Contains 365 steps (one per day).
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, New Seven Wonders of the World

properties.name: Tikal
properties.description: Majestic Maya city-state with Temple I rising 47m above the jungle canopy. Royal tombs contained jade masks and offerings to the underworld.

properties.name: Cenotes of Yucatán
properties.description: Sacred natural sinkholes that were portals to Xibalba (the Maya underworld). Bodies and offerings have been found in their depths.
properties.modernStatus: Tourist and diving sites, some still sacred

properties.name: Palenque — Temple of Inscriptions
properties.description: Contains the tomb of K'inich Janaab Pakal with its famous carved sarcophagus lid showing the king descending into Xibalba.
